suggestion.root_cause: The new overlay element ('.signin-overlay') added above the 'Sign in' button on mobile (below 640px width) is positioned with a high z-index and covers the button, intercepting user input clicks and preventing the sign-in button from receiving click events while remaining visible and enabled.
suggestion.suggestion_markdown: Remove or disable the overlay element on mobile that sits above the 'Sign in' button by adjusting the CSS or HTML markup so it does not cover the interactive button area. Specifically, hide the '.signin-overlay' or reduce its z-index below the button's stacking context to allow input events to pass through and enable clicking the sign-in button on mobile screens.
